stage0100a_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$メラン$$
「Distortion of the dimensional boundary, still continuing!」

stage0100a_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Is this a sign that the Prison of Time is about to vanish...?」

stage0100a_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$シャア$$
「There's also a chance something's transferring in.」

stage0100a_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ミサト$$
「We haven't even finished repairing the damage
　from the fight with the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...!」

stage0100a_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The bloodied eyes are still continuing...!」

stage0100a_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$n
（What is this...
　It's the same as when I first encountered Geminis...）

stage0100a_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$宗介$$
「Is it some kind of weapon?」

stage0100a_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$尸空$$
「So you sensed me...
　You must be the new $$スフィア・リアクター$$.」

stage0100a_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$尸空$$
「You're still unrefined...
　At that level, it looks like it'll be a while
　before you can stand alongside us.」

stage0100a_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$シモン$$
「Are you an ally of $$ガドライト$$'s!?」

stage0100a_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$尸空$$
「...'Ally' isn't quite the right word,
　but I am a member of the same organization.」

stage0100a_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$尸空$$
「My name is $$尸空$$.
　I belong to Kishuku, within the Sidereal.」

stage0100a_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「It seems $$ガドライト$$'s Geminis
　was a unit of that organization.」

stage0100a_04:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$尸空$$
「It helps that you're quick on the uptake.」

stage0100a_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$尸空$$
「While I'm at it, I'll tell you this too.
　I am also the Reactor of 'the Silent Giant Crab'.」

stage0100a_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$桂$$
「So now, of all times, a new $$スフィア・リアクター$$!」

stage0100a_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$正太郎$$
「The machine he's using is the same as Geminis...!」

stage0100a_04:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, stay alert!
　Since he's a Reactor too, he'll use the $$スフィア$$'s power
　just like $$ガドライト$$ did!」

stage0100a_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「The energy radiating off him...」

stage0100a_04:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$桂$$
「Touching that feels like it kills your very spirit...」

stage0100a_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「That guy... did he come to avenge $$ガドライト$$...!」

stage0100a_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$尸空$$
「...I have no interest in that.」

stage0100a_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$尸空$$
「I'll complete the mission in 3 minutes.
　Let's go.」

stage0100a_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You will confess everything!
　The true nature and goal of this so-called Sidereal!」

stage0100a_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$尸空$$
「But that is precisely why you'll be destroyed.」

stage0100a_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$赤木$$
「Tough luck!
　Your guaranteed knockout was a bust!」

stage0100a_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ゼロ$$
「You will confess everything!
　The true nature and goal of this so-called Sidereal!」

stage0100a_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$尸空$$
「But that is precisely why you'll be destroyed.」

stage0100a_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$アマタ$$
「He definitely wasn't an easy opponent,
　but compared to $$ガドライト$$...」

stage0100a_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$n
「...I don't think that's all he's really capable of...」

stage0100a_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$n
「$$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the Silent Giant Crab... $$尸空$$...」

stage0100a_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$宗介$$
「If the bloodied eyes appeared, that would mean
　he really is the Angel that's your family's enemy, wouldn't it?」

stage0100a_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アルト$$
「He felt less like an Angel and more like a Messenger of Death, though...」

stage0100a_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...It's time.
　All units, brace for impact and stand ready.」

stage0100a_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「The destruction of the Prison of Time through $$時空修復$$...
　So this is its final moment.」

stage0100a_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$アムロ$$
「With the threat of Geminis swept away,
　the world will greet a new era.」

stage0100a_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$竜馬$$
「But we can't let our guard down.」

stage0100a_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Someday, $$バアル$$ will come to Earth...
　We have to be ready for that.」

stage0100a_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$アルト$$
「And there's also that guy from before, the one called $$尸空$$.」

stage0100a_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$甲児$$
「It's not just Earth we're protecting.
　It's the entire universe.」

stage0100a_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$シモン$$
「Yeah...
　That's what we swore to do.」

stage0100a_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$タケル$$
「First, let's see our victory through.」

stage0100a_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If possible, after that... I'd like to rest a little.」

stage0100a_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah.
　Both us and our machines are worn out.」

stage0100a_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$葵$$
「Even we could use a bit of rest right about now.」

stage0100a_04:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$ロジャー$$
「A brief moment of peace, huh...
　Not bad.」

stage0100a_04:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The countdown has begun...
　The Prison of Time will collapse soon.」

stage0100a_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Good work, $n.
　Thank you, for everything up to today.」

stage0100a_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$尸空$$
「A life frozen in place... the Prison of Time...
　It really must be a boring world...」

stage0100a_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$尸空$$
「But you could call it paradise, too.
　...You'll regret choosing to escape from it.」

stage0100a_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$尸空$$
「The hope and despair inside you...
　That's what's drawing out the power of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$' $$スフィア$$, is it...」

stage0100a_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$尸空$$
「But it's not enough, not yet.
　You still lack what it takes for us to accept you.」

stage0100a_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$n
「Don't think you can keep acting so at ease forever!」

stage0100a_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$n
「Let's do this...!
　I'll defeat you and bring the truth of the bloodied eyes to light!」
